content: The outcomes of prosthetics and orthotics treatments must be thoroughly evaluated and meticulously documented to ensure their effectiveness and appropriateness. Individuals utilizing prosthetic and orthotic services should be monitored and followed up with on a regular basis to assess their progress and address any emerging needs or complications. Annual and long-term strategic and operational plans should be established, incorporating performance indicators to facilitate continuous monitoring and improvement of service delivery. The required quality standards for prosthetics and orthotics services must be clearly defined and strictly adhered to at all levels and across all components of the service delivery system.
